description: This file contains the code-behind for the 'EditTheory' web page in an ASP.NET Web Forms application. It manages navigation actions (button clicks), session handling, and dynamic population of course selection dropdowns based on semester selection. The code facilitates navigation between different pages and populates course lists for different academic years and semesters.

classes.name: OnlineExamSystem.EditTheory
classes.description: Partial class for the EditTheory page, handling page events and business logic.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles initial page load event; currently does nothing.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Handles clicking the home button; transfers user to AdminPanel.aspx.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Handles clicking the profile button; transfers to AdminQueue.aspx.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Handles clicking the leaderboard button; transfers to AdminLeaderboard.aspx.

methods.name: searchB_Click
methods.description: Stores selected course in session variable '_CRS'.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out user by transferring to LoginPage.aspx.

methods.name: selectB_Click
methods.description: Populates course dropdown based on selected semester.

methods.name: selectSemesterDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Handles change in semester dropdown; repopulates course list accordingly.

methods.name: SelectCourseDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Event placeholder for when course dropdown selection changes, currently does nothing.
